text.card: A star about 130 parsecs away, 5.6 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 5.6 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,762 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 131496
quotes.card: HD 131496, officially named Arcalís, is an evolved subgiant star with an orbiting exoplanet in the constellation Boötes.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent visual magnitude of 7.9 it is too faint to be visible to the naked eye.
